# Hover Card

Preview of linked content for sighted mouse users, shown on hover or focus. Its content is supplementary: the link itself must make sense without it.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `hover-card.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library. Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
